svg.desc: Every block at every gate: not due, met or gap
svg.text: Figure 2 · What the gate scrubber shows
Each block at each gate, by the page's own rule: a block is due from its exit gate, and is met once its least mature record reaches the rung the page asks for (left
side baselined, right side verified). The rule is a placeholder for real exit criteria. At the current gate G0: 1 gap.
Gap: due and below the rung
· not due yet at that gate

Generated by tools/figures/vcycle_readme.py from the records through tools/vcycle/build_vcycle.py and the rules in page.html. Maturity is computed from record status for orientation only; nothing here is reviewed, verified or

g.text: Terms: G0–G7 = lifecycle gate (G0 concept to G7 change and sustainment) · R01 … = validator rule in tools/pdac (R13 = only a named human review accepts anything)
